args.body:
Hi Priya,

Following up on the login loop customer incident you reported. We need some additional diagnostic information to investigate this issue thoroughly.

Could you please provide the following missing diagnostics:

1. Server logs from the affected time period
2. Client-side browser console logs from when the login loop occurs
3. Network trace/capture showing the authentication flow and any redirect loops
4. Authentication service logs
5. Any specific error messages or stack traces observed

If there are any specific user accounts, browsers, or times of day when this issue occurs more frequently, please include that information as well.

This will help us identify the root cause and resolve the login loop issue more quickly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
